name: Roen Stillhand
descriptor: a wandering ranger with a debt and a long memory
quote: I left home one moonless night and the road forgot to give me back.

themes.title: Child of the Greenmarch
themes.quest: Whose voices still call me home?
weakness_tags: owes a debt to the Warden
themes.quest_description: What do you still owe the people who raised you, and what will it cost to repay it?
special_improvements: When you return to a place from your past, take a power tag for the scene.

themes.title: The Yew Bow
themes.quest: What will I make this old bow remember?
themes.quest_description: Each shot writes a small history into the wood. Where will the bow's story end?
special_improvements: Once per session, treat a missed shot as a partial success at a cost.

themes.title: The Last Caravan
themes.quest: What did I see that night I will not name?
themes.quest_description: The caravan never reached its destination. You did. The rest is still owed an answer.
special_improvements: When you encounter someone tied to that night, you may name a true thing about them.

themes.title: The Warden's Errand
themes.quest: How far will I go to keep this oath?
power_tags: right of passage on the green roads
themes.quest_description: You carry an authority older than the realm. It can be invoked — but never twice for the same favour.
special_improvements: When you invoke the Warden's name openly, gain a status that lasts the scene.
